summary.text: Shafina Barnett, a Green Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 4th District to Sean McCann.
Barnett ran against Republican incumbent Bill Huizenga and Democratic nominee Sean McCann.
Shafina Barnett received 1.5% of the vote to Sean McCann's 50.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan, 2026
